blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Gabrielle Galapia of the Philippines has taken another step closer to the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International crown and has now taken a spot among the Top 15. The competition at Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City started with 38 aspirants in total, which was later trimmed to just 25 semifinalists. The Filipino contender gained a semifinals berth by winning both the Best in Swimsuit and Best in Evening Gown awards at the Preliminary Competition. The 25 semifinalists competed in the swimsuit round to earn their spots in the Top 15, who will battle it our again on […]...
